How it works

Three screens.
That’s it.

Capture what you ate, check your day, watch the trend. Real screens from the app, rendered with demo data.

Drag to rotate

  1. 01 · Capture

    Snap, say or type.

    One capture screen for photos, voice, text, barcodes and manual entry. Pick whatever is quickest right now.

  2. 02 · Journal

    Your day at a glance.

    Calories and macros add up as you go. Edit a meal, repeat a favourite, or jump to any day on the calendar.

  3. 03 · Progress

    Trends, not guilt.

    Weigh-ins, weekly and monthly trends and a streak that rewards showing up, with freezes for the days life gets in the way.

Features

Small details.
Big difference.

Snap, say or type

Photo, voice, text, barcode or manual. AI estimates calories, protein, carbs and fat, and shows how sure it is.

Voice stays on your phone

Speech is transcribed on-device with Whisper. Your recording never leaves the phone.

You have the final say

Every estimate goes through a review screen. Unknown values stay blank, never zero.

469cited NZ servings

Food search, made for NZ

Cited servings for New Zealand products and restaurants, plus USDA and Open Food Facts. Barcodes decode on-device.

Streaks with freezes

Consistency over perfection. A freeze covers the day you couldn’t log.

Friends, if you want

Cheer each other on. Friends see your streak, never your meals, weight or photos.

Your data, your call

No ads and no tracking. Export your journal or delete your account from Settings.

Home-screen widgets

On Android: a streak counter and one-tap shortcuts to capture, scan or dictate.

Privacy

Your journal is
nobody’s business.

  • Voice is transcribed on your phone. Recordings never leave it.
  • Photos are sent for an estimate only when you ask, and aren’t stored on our servers.
  • No ads, no analytics SDK, no tracking.
  • Friends see your streak, never your meals, weight or photos.
  • Delete your account and its data from Settings.

Support

Questions,
answered.

Still stuck? admin@kokonut.cc

Privacy policy Account deletion

How do I get Haste?

Haste is in closed testing on Google Play. Email us from a Google account and we’ll add you to the tester list. The iPhone version is in preparation.

Does it cost anything?

Haste is free while it’s in testing. There are no ads.

How accurate are the AI estimates?

They’re estimates, and they can be wrong. Haste shows its confidence and asks you to review portions and values before saving. Use a label or a database entry when you have one. Haste is not a medical device.

Where is my journal stored?

Meals are saved on your phone first, then synced privately to your account. Voice is transcribed on the device. Photos are sent for an AI estimate only when you choose to.

How do I delete my account?

Use Delete account in Settings. The account deletion page explains what is removed.
